description: This Dart source file defines the ExportService class, which provides cross-platform export functionality for saving a sample PDF asset to user-selected locations using system save dialogs. It leverages platform-specific capabilities such as the file_selector package for file-saving operations, supports web download hints, and includes internal methods for loading sample assets and formatting error messages.

classes.name: ExportService
classes.description: Provides methods for exporting a sample PDF asset to user-defined locations, handling platform differences and potential errors.

methods.name: exportSamplePdfToUserLocation
methods.description: Loads a sample PDF from assets, prompts the user to select a save location via system dialogs, saves the PDF, and returns a path or a description of where the file was saved.

methods.name: _loadSamplePdfBytes
methods.description: Loads the sample PDF bytes from embedded assets.

methods.name: _friendlyMessage
methods.description: Simplifies error messages for user display.
